title: alpha-Chaconine as a Potential Inhibitor of Mutant Phosphatidylinositol 3-Kinase Alpha in Breast Cancer Stem Cells: Insights from Structure Prediction and Molecular Dynamics.
authors: Saputra, Bakti Wahyu; Ujiantari, Navista Sri Octa; Rattyananda, Badra Sanditya; Alwi, Ratna Surya; Setiawati, Agustina; Hermawan, Adam
journal: Asian Pacific journal of cancer prevention : APJCP
one_liner_zh: 该文通过同源建模、分子对接和分子动力学模拟，评估alpha-Chaconine对突变PI3Kα的抑制潜力，属于蛋白质结构预测与MD模拟的工程化应用，方法常规但对象和问题明确。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Breast cancer stem cells (BCSCs) promote chemoresistance and metastasis by activating aberrant signaling pathways such as phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B (PI3K/Akt). alpha-Chaconine (CHA) is a steroidal glycoalkaloid that has demonstrated cytotoxic and antiproliferative activity in various cancer models, possibly through modulation of the PI3K/Akt pathway. However, its direct interaction with PI3Kalpha and related alterations has not yet been elucidated. This study aimed to assess CHA as a potential BCSC-targeting agent, particularly as a PI3K inhibitor targeting both wild-type and mutant PI3Kalpha, using an in silico approach. METHODS: Mutation data were retrieved from cBioPortal and analyzed using MutPred2. SWISS-MODEL was used to generate homology models of the wild-type and mutant PI3Kalpha structures. Structural validation was performed using PROCHECK and ERRAT. Molecular docking was employed to evaluate the binding affinity of the PI3Kalpha-CHA complex. Molecular dynamics simulations were conducted to assess the stability of the interaction between CHA and PI3Kalpha. RESULTS: Three PIK3CA mutations were identified as pathogenic: E542K, E545K, and H1047R. Molecular docking revealed a strong binding affinity of alpelisib to both wild-type and mutant (E542K, E545K, and H1047R) forms of p110 alpha. CHA exhibited the lowest binding energy with the H1047R mutant, with a docking score of -9.93 kcal/mol. Molecular dynamics simulations demonstrated stable interactions of alpelisib with wild-type, E542K, and E545K mutants, whereas CHA showed stable interaction only with the H1047R mutant. MM-PBSA calculations confirmed the lowest binding free energies for alpelisib-wild-type p110alpha and CHA-H1047R complexes, with values of -29.21 kcal/mol and -25.88 kcal/mol, respectively. CONCLUSION: These findings provide a basis for further in vitro and in vivo studies to evaluate CHA as a selective PI3K inhibitor targeting the H1047R PIK3CA mutation in breast cancer stem cells.
abstract_zh: 引言：乳腺癌干细胞（BCSCs）通过激活异常信号通路（如磷脂酰肌醇3-激酶/蛋白激酶B（PI3K/Akt））促进化疗耐药和转移。α-查茄碱（CHA）是一种甾体糖生物碱，已在多种癌症模型中显示出细胞毒性和抗增殖活性，可能通过调节PI3K/Akt通路实现。然而，其与PI3Kα的直接相互作用及相关改变尚未阐明。本研究旨在通过计算机模拟方法评估CHA作为潜在的靶向BCSCs药物，特别是作为靶向野生型和突变型PI3Kα的PI3K抑制剂。方法：从cBioPortal获取突变数据，并使用MutPred2进行分析。使用SWISS-MODEL生成野生型和突变型PI3Kα结构的同源模型。使用PROCHECK和ERRAT进行结构验证。采用分子对接评估PI3Kα-CHA复合物的结合亲和力。进行分子动力学模拟以评估CHA与PI3Kα之间相互作用的稳定性。结果：三个PIK3CA突变被鉴定为致病性：E542K、E545K和H1047R。分子对接显示alpelisib对野生型和突变型（E542K、E545K和H1047R）p110α形式均具有强结合亲和力。CHA与H1047R突变体表现出最低结合能，对接评分为-9.93 kcal/mol。分子动力学模拟显示alpelisib与野生型、E542K和E545K突变体具有稳定相互作用，而CHA仅与H1047R突变体表现出稳定相互作用。MM-PBSA计算确认alpelisib-野生型p110α和CHA-H1047R复合物的结合自由能最低，分别为-29.21 kcal/mol和-25.88 kcal/mol。结论：这些发现为进一步的体外和体内研究提供了基础，以评估CHA作为靶向乳腺癌干细胞中H1047R PIK3CA突变的选择性PI3K抑制剂。
